answer: Every attestation carries a canyon echo: a merkle root of the attester's own on-ledger history plus sign height. Weight scales with canyon depth, the attester's own tx count since its first tx, so a twin spawned at height H opens with an empty canyon and near-zero weight. New identities sign from a lagoon lane: seals count only toward lagoon quorum until canyon depth passes the cohort median, then pigment deposits into the main basin. Deepening the canyon takes real epochs of distinct on-ledger work; the root re-verifies from the chain. A farm must run each twin at full live time.
